2609.18072.title: Teaching AI, Robotics, & Community: A Hubs-Based K-12 Education Framework for Reaching Rural Schools
2609.18072.paper_summary: K-12 robotics and AI education remains difficult to scale, especially in rural regions lacking sustained technical mentorship. Programs like FIRST provide competition pathways and instructional opportunities, but they do not eliminate the need for local programming and robotics expertise. We introduce AI, Robotics, & Community (ARC), a hubs-based framework where colleges train undergraduate mentors and host workshops for nearby K-12 teams. Mature school programs can become secondary hubs that support additional schools, creating a self-reinforcing education loop where mentorship reach propagates geographically and can even grow super-linearly. We first evaluate ARC through a trial deployment at one university. The trial created three rural robotics teams. On five-point Likert surveys, mean increases in K-12 programming knowledge, resource access, and practice opportunities were 2.00, 2.25, and 1.25 points. Likewise, undergraduate confidence teaching technical concepts, adapting explanations, managing groups, and finding mentoring enjoyable and meaningful increased by 1.29, 1.14, 1.00, and 1.14 points. Additionally, we create a spatial Markov model of ARC's growth and simulate it using the state of Indiana as a testbed. Under moderate conditions, we find that ARC reaches 74% of Indiana's 1,925 public K-12 schools and produces 992 robotics programs after 40 years, compared with 161 projected under natural growth alone. Together, these results show ARC can create and support rural robotics programs, train undergraduate AI and robotics mentors, and potentially scale mentorship across a region.
2609.18072.paper_summary_zh: K-12 機器人和人工智慧教育在擴展上仍然面臨困難，尤其是在缺乏持續技術指導的農村地區。像 FIRST 這樣的計畫提供了競賽途徑和教學機會，但它們並未消除對當地編程和機器人專業知識的需求。我們介紹了 AI、機器人與社區（ARC），這是一個基於中心的框架，讓大學培訓本科生導師並為附近的 K-12 團隊舉辦工作坊。成熟的學校計畫可以成為次級中心，支持其他學校，創造一個自我增強的教育循環，在這個循環中，導師的影響力在地理上擴展，甚至可以超線性增長。我們首先通過在一所大學的試點部署來評估 ARC。該試點創建了三個農村機器人團隊。在五點李克特調查中，K-12 編程知識、資源獲取和實踐機會的平均增長分別為 2.00、2.25 和 1.25 分。同樣，本科生在教授技術概念、調整解釋、管理團體以及發現指導工作有趣且有意義的自信心分別增加了 1.29、1.14、1.00 和 1.14 分。此外，我們創建了 ARC 增長的空間馬爾可夫模型，並使用印第安納州作為測試平台進行模擬。在適度條件下，我們發現 ARC 覆蓋了印第安納州 1,925 所公立 K-12 學校的 74%，並在 40 年後產生了 992 個機器人計畫，而自然增長預測僅為 161。綜合這些結果顯示，ARC 可以創建和支持農村機器人計畫，培訓本科生 AI 和機器人導師，並有可能在一個地區內擴展導師的影響力。
